accounting.CPU_wall: operational provenance only; not search performance
accounting.bit_quantiles: pooled per query-object pair, linear interpolation; mean and per-query distributions also reported
accounting.persistent: complete representation header and payload; no entropy compression or duplicated raw search source
accounting.primary: mean logical DISTINCT incremental source-layer payload bytes per query; decimal GB
accounting.raw_oracle_reads: quality validation only, excluded from ideal service source-byte model and recorded separately
accounting.secondary: query bytes, header, decoder metadata, retained prefixes, IDs/flags/compaction and validator storage separately disclosed

execution.prequalification: bit-corner fixtures, all prefix endpoint cases, small range equality/empty/duplicates/finite validation; first4096 of every frozen query before full pool

format.layer_order: all row-major coordinates for one layer, then next layer; adjacent coordinate nibbles share a byte
format.mapping: u sign set -> ~u, otherwise u xor 0x80000000; inverse bit permutation, no arithmetic transform
format.nonfinite: all bit patterns recoverable; dense L2 service rejects NaN/inf objects or queries at admission; finite intervals clip NaN/inf key tails
format.row_padding: nibbles pad only for odd D; D960 has none
format.signed_zero: distinct bit patterns preserved; both numerically zero
format.source: candidate receives only four layer pointers and the full query; raw input/oracles are validation-only

gates.CONDITIONAL: valid but not GO and mean <=850000000; no GPU
gates.GO: all correctness/ownership/size gates and source mean <=710380143.2
gates.Gate1: only GO permits separate fully frozen GPU campaign; NOT_RUN until that gate
gates.human_clarification: 2026-10-13 approved correctness/single-source/size failure first, then GO <=0.70 times exact baseline, then CONDITIONAL <=0.85GB, else NO_GO

numerics.bound: project full FP32 query to interval; one-ULP downward after difference, square and each ordered sum; max with previous safe bound; reject strictly > cutoff
numerics.compile: no fast-math or contraction, IEEE FP64 round-to-nearest
numerics.final: reconstruct original FP32 bits then original-coordinate ordered FP64 accumulation, bit compare with frozen oracle
numerics.interval: intersect key prefix window with all finite FP32 keys [0x00800000,0xff7fffff], inverse-map exact endpoints

publication: source, scalar counts, validation receipts and figures only; original vectors/full outputs/placement/source PDFs stay private
scope: One CPU logical source-byte falsification; no GPU performance or research-novelty promotion

workload.duplicates: row occurrence identity; no deduplication; self matches retained
workload.inclusive_membership: ordered FP64 sum of squared FP32 differences <= cutoff
